SELECT ri.rental_id, ri.file_id, f.storage_key, ri.kind, ri.sort_order
FROM rental_images ri
INNER JOIN files f ON f.id = ri.file_id
WHERE f.status = 1 AND f.purpose = 'RENTAL_IMAGE'
AND ri.rental_id IN
#{rentalId}
AND 1 = 0
ORDER BY ri.rental_id ASC, ri.kind ASC, ri.sort_order ASC, ri.id ASC

SELECT rs.rental_id, rs.station_id, s.name, s.line_name, rs.walking_minutes
FROM rental_stations rs
INNER JOIN stations s ON s.id = rs.station_id
WHERE 1 = 1
AND rs.rental_id IN
#{rentalId}
AND 1 = 0
ORDER BY rs.rental_id ASC, rs.walking_minutes ASC, rs.station_id ASC

SELECT rf.rental_id, rf.feature_id, f.code, f.name, f.category
FROM rental_feature_relations rf
INNER JOIN rental_features f ON f.id = rf.feature_id
WHERE f.status = 1
AND rf.rental_id IN
#{rentalId}
AND 1 = 0
ORDER BY rf.rental_id ASC, f.category ASC, f.sort_order ASC, f.id ASC

SELECT code, name, category
FROM rental_features
WHERE status = 1 AND category IN ('AMENITY', 'CONDITION')
ORDER BY category ASC, sort_order ASC, id ASC

SELECT r.*
FROM rentals r
WHERE r.status = 1 AND r.review_status = 2
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM companies c WHERE c.id = r.company_id AND c.status = 1 )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM users u WHERE u.id = r.agent_id AND u.company_id = r.company_id AND u.status = 1 )
AND r.id IN
#{rentalId}
AND 1 = 0

SELECT r.* FROM rentals r WHERE r.id = #{id} AND r.status = 1 AND r.review_status = 2 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM companies c WHERE c.id = r.company_id AND c.status = 1 ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM users u WHERE u.id = r.agent_id AND u.company_id = r.company_id AND u.status = 1 )

SELECT u.id, u.nickname AS name, f.storage_key AS avatar_storage_key, c.name AS company, c.business_hours, c.closed_days FROM rentals r INNER JOIN users u ON u.id = r.agent_id AND u.company_id = r.company_id AND u.status = 1 INNER JOIN companies c ON c.id = r.company_id AND c.status = 1 LEFT JOIN files f ON f.id = u.avatar_file_id AND f.owner_id = u.id AND f.purpose = 'AVATAR' AND f.status = 1 WHERE r.id = #{rentalId} AND r.status = 1 AND r.review_status = 2

SELECT mc.name, mc.address, mc.license_number, mc.email FROM rentals r INNER JOIN companies mc ON mc.id = r.management_company_id AND mc.status = 1 INNER JOIN companies c ON c.id = r.company_id AND c.status = 1 INNER JOIN users u ON u.id = r.agent_id AND u.company_id = r.company_id AND u.status = 1 WHERE r.id = #{rentalId} AND r.status = 1 AND r.review_status = 2

SELECT r.id, r.name, r.address, r.description, r.area_code AS areaCode, r.property_type AS propertyType, r.monthly_rent AS monthlyRent, r.management_fee AS managementFee, r.floor_plan AS floorPlan, r.area_sqm AS area, r.built_year AS builtYear, r.built_month AS builtMonth, r.latitude, r.longitude, r.published_at AS publishedAt, r.company_id AS companyId, r.agent_id AS agentId
FROM rentals r
INNER JOIN companies c ON c.id = r.company_id AND c.status = 1
INNER JOIN users u ON u.id = r.agent_id AND u.company_id = r.company_id AND u.status = 1
WHERE r.status = 1 AND r.review_status = 2 AND r.id > #{afterId} AND r.id <= #{upperId}
ORDER BY r.id ASC
LIMIT #{limit}
